title: Network Effects
hook: The best products get better every time someone joins. Most don't.
statement: Every new user makes it more valuable for everyone.
explainer: People stay because others are there. Leaving costs the network. That's a moat.
sop: Name what each new user adds.
Show new users what others are doing.
Protect early users while you grow.
equation_example: 10 Users squared = 100. 100 Users squared = 10,000. Faster than a straight line.
question: Write what one new user gives every other user.
closing_statement: Design for what users give each other.
